meta.name: work-status
meta.description: Shows WORK progress and TASK status. Use when the user asks about WORK list, WORK progress, TASK status, or pipeline status (e.g., "WORK list", "WORK-01 progress", "show status").

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看工作进度和任务状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要随时了解工作列表和任务进展
copy.tagline_en: Check work progress and task status
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to stay updated on work items and task status

howto.what: Claude 会读取工作列表和任务进度文件，然后以表格形式展示每个工作项的状态、进度和完成情况。
howto.when: 当你询问工作列表、工作进度、任务状态或流水线状态时触发，例如说“工作列表”、“WORK-01 进度”或“显示状态”。

say.text: 显示所有进行中的工作

howto.what_en: Claude reads work list and task progress files, then displays each work item's status, progress, and completion in a table format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about work list, work progress, task status, or pipeline status, e.g., "work list", "WORK-01 progress", or "show status".

say_en.note: Claude reads WORK-LIST.md and displays all work items with status.
Claude reads WORK-01's PROGRESS.md and reports task-level progress.
Claude filters and displays works with IN_PROGRESS status.
